own: Totally agree with design. You can block and unblock people with the click of a mouse. There is going to be a section for blocked users where you can see a list of the people that have been blocked. You can also leave notes for each person you've blocked so you can remember the reason why, and it records the time and date that you blocked them. You don't have to fill in the notes, but if you do want to put a note as to why you blocked them, you can.
